comments.author: Misun
comments.body:
Here's some more info on the Lima adventure quest titled 'Terror seen in the caves'

1. Valparaiso - Talk to Young Man twice

2. Beunos Aires - Talk to merchant, then tavern keeper, then resident.

3. South America South-East Coast (landing point) - go to area of pointed boulder #2 and use observe or click boulder for directions to location.

for those of you who can't read Korean, like me..
north is large boulder or rock, not sure of exact name
north west is red flowers, not sure of exact name
south central is 'pointed boulder' #1
west is 'pointed boulder' #2
